blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — Police seized about nine kilograms of suspected marijuana worth P1.016 million and arrested a 21-year-old man in a buy-bust operation in General Santos City on Friday night, Oct. 16. The suspect, identified only as alias “Mels,” of Barangay Fatima, was arrested at around 8:42 p.m. in Silway Darimco, Barangay Dadiangas West, according to the Police Regional Office 12 (PRO 12).
